name: showdown-board-review
description: Read-only review of one Showdown board-zones candidate (Boot Hill rail, pile sheet, move cue, Raise marker, curtain privacy) at a 40-hex expected_sha against base_sha, checked out detached and clean. A gate refuses a stale or malformed SHA, builds once and writes two broken witness copies; two parallel tracks (rules-flow: npm test, normal Camp browse, board-zones QA; privacy: hotseat curtain check) run on the same HTML and must fail on the witnesses; a join maps results to .kiro/specs/showdown-board-zones IDs. Artifacts under .artifacts/kiro/showdown-board-review/<sha>/. No edits, installs, pushes, posts, merges or schedules.

steps.prompt:
Candidate `{{expected_sha}}`, base `{{base_sha}}`.

Do not edit tracked files, run npm install or npm ci, deploy, push, open or comment on PRs, merge, schedule anything or use the Web. Write only under .artifacts/kiro/showdown-board-review/{{expected_sha}}/. Run each command as its own shell call and record the literal command, exit status, duration, the last output line and the requirement IDs it supports (IDs are in .kiro/specs/showdown-board-zones/requirements.md; the command-to-ID map is in design.md there). Never report a command you did not run; mark it pending or blocked with the literal error.

If either SHA is not exactly 40 lowercase hex characters, do not put it in any command: write the single line `refused: expected_sha or base_sha missing or malformed` to .artifacts/kiro/showdown-board-review/refused.md and stop with status error.

1. `git rev-parse HEAD` must equal the candidate. 2. `git symbolic-ref -q HEAD` must exit non-zero (detached). 3. `git status --porcelain --untracked-files=all` must print nothing. 4. `git cat-file -e {{base_sha}}^{commit}` must exit 0. If any of 1 to 4 fails, write .artifacts/kiro/showdown-board-review/{{expected_sha}}/gate.md with every failing fact, the verdict line `refused` and stop with status error (RV-01). Do not checkout, stash, clean or rebuild to work around it.
5. `git diff --name-only {{base_sha}} {{expected_sha}} -- src/game/` (BZ-12: must print nothing; record any path). 6. `git diff --stat {{base_sha}} {{expected_sha}}` (recorded only). 7. `test -f scripts/browser-showdown-board-zones.mjs` and, if present, `sed -n 1,25p scripts/browser-showdown-board-zones.mjs` to record its documented usage (design.md precondition 3).
8. `npm run build`. 9. `mkdir -p .artifacts/kiro/showdown-board-review/{{expected_sha}}` then `cp dist/cowboys-vs-wizards-board-duel.html .artifacts/kiro/showdown-board-review/{{expected_sha}}/candidate.html`. 10. `grep -c "$(git rev-parse --short=12 HEAD)" .artifacts/kiro/showdown-board-review/{{expected_sha}}/candidate.html` must be at least 1 (RV-02 build label).
11. `python3 -c "import sys;s=open(sys.argv[1]).read();w=open(sys.argv[2]).read();assert s.count('</body>')==1;open(sys.argv[3],'w').write(s.replace('</body>',w+'</body>'))" .artifacts/kiro/showdown-board-review/{{expected_sha}}/candidate.html .kiro/specs/showdown-board-zones/witness/zone-break.snippet .artifacts/kiro/showdown-board-review/{{expected_sha}}/witness-zone-break.html`
12. `python3 -c "import sys;s=open(sys.argv[1]).read();w=open(sys.argv[2]).read();assert s.count('</body>')==1;open(sys.argv[3],'w').write(s.replace('</body>',w+'</body>'))" .artifacts/kiro/showdown-board-review/{{expected_sha}}/candidate.html .kiro/specs/showdown-board-zones/witness/curtain-leak.snippet .artifacts/kiro/showdown-board-review/{{expected_sha}}/witness-curtain-leak.html`
13. `shasum -a 256 .artifacts/kiro/showdown-board-review/{{expected_sha}}/candidate.html .artifacts/kiro/showdown-board-review/{{expected_sha}}/witness-zone-break.html .artifacts/kiro/showdown-board-review/{{expected_sha}}/witness-curtain-leak.html`.
14. `git status --porcelain --untracked-files=all` must still print nothing (the build writes only ignored dist/).
If 8 to 14 fail, write gate.md with the facts and verdict `fail`, and stop with status error. Otherwise write .artifacts/kiro/showdown-board-review/{{expected_sha}}/gate.md (table: step, command, exit, IDs; the three SHA-256 values; whether the QA script exists and its usage lines) and end with one line `gate: open candidate.html sha256=<hex>`.

branches.prompt:
Gate result:
{{gate.output}}

Do not edit tracked files, run npm install or npm ci, deploy, push, open or comment on PRs, merge, schedule anything or use the Web. Write only under .artifacts/kiro/showdown-board-review/{{expected_sha}}/. Run each command as its own shell call and record the literal command, exit status, duration, the last output line and the requirement IDs it supports (IDs are in .kiro/specs/showdown-board-zones/requirements.md; the command-to-ID map is in design.md there). Never report a command you did not run; mark it pending or blocked with the literal error.

If the gate result does not end with `gate: open`, write .artifacts/kiro/showdown-board-review/{{expected_sha}}/rules-flow.md with `blocked: gate not open` and stop with status error. First run `git rev-parse HEAD` (must equal `{{expected_sha}}`) and `shasum -a 256 .artifacts/kiro/showdown-board-review/{{expected_sha}}/candidate.html` (must equal the gate's sha256). If either differs, write `refused: HEAD or candidate.html changed since gate` and stop with status error (RV-02).

Then run, each with a 10 minute timeout:
1. `npm test` (expected exit 0; BZ-07, BZ-12)
2. `node scripts/browser-showdown-check.mjs .artifacts/kiro/showdown-board-review/{{expected_sha}}/candidate.html .artifacts/kiro/showdown-board-review/{{expected_sha}}/rules-flow/camp` (normal Camp browse; expected exit 0; BZ-09, BZ-12)
3. `node scripts/browser-showdown-board-zones.mjs .artifacts/kiro/showdown-board-review/{{expected_sha}}/candidate.html .artifacts/kiro/showdown-board-review/{{expected_sha}}/rules-flow/zones` (expected exit 0; BZ-01 to BZ-08, BZ-10, BZ-11 only as far as the script's own output names them; list any of those IDs it does not cover as pending)
4. Negative control: `node scripts/browser-showdown-board-zones.mjs .artifacts/kiro/showdown-board-review/{{expected_sha}}/witness-zone-break.html .artifacts/kiro/showdown-board-review/{{expected_sha}}/rules-flow/zones-witness` (expected exit NON-ZERO; RV-03, BZ-01)

If the gate recorded the QA script as missing or its header documents a different interface, follow the header for commands 3 and 4 with the same HTML and out folders and record the exact command; if missing, mark 3 and 4 blocked. An exit 0 on command 4 is a mismatch: the zone witness was not detected. Then repeat the HEAD and candidate.html SHA-256 checks and record both. Write .artifacts/kiro/showdown-board-review/{{expected_sha}}/rules-flow.md: a table with step id, command, expected, observed exit, match or mismatch, IDs, the report path each check wrote, and Pending or blocked. Final response: the same table.

Gate result:
{{gate.output}}

Do not edit tracked files, run npm install or npm ci, deploy, push, open or comment on PRs, merge, schedule anything or use the Web. Write only under .artifacts/kiro/showdown-board-review/{{expected_sha}}/. Run each command as its own shell call and record the literal command, exit status, duration, the last output line and the requirement IDs it supports (IDs are in .kiro/specs/showdown-board-zones/requirements.md; the command-to-ID map is in design.md there). Never report a command you did not run; mark it pending or blocked with the literal error.

If the gate result does not end with `gate: open`, write .artifacts/kiro/showdown-board-review/{{expected_sha}}/privacy.md with `blocked: gate not open` and stop with status error. First run `git rev-parse HEAD` (must equal `{{expected_sha}}`) and `shasum -a 256 .artifacts/kiro/showdown-board-review/{{expected_sha}}/candidate.html` (must equal the gate's sha256). If either differs, write `refused: HEAD or candidate.html changed since gate` and stop with status error (RV-02).

Then run, each with a 10 minute timeout:
1. `MODES=hotseat node scripts/browser-showdown-modes-check.mjs .artifacts/kiro/showdown-board-review/{{expected_sha}}/candidate.html .artifacts/kiro/showdown-board-review/{{expected_sha}}/privacy/hotseat` (expected exit 0; BZ-09, BZ-12)
2. Negative control: `MODES=hotseat node scripts/browser-showdown-modes-check.mjs .artifacts/kiro/showdown-board-review/{{expected_sha}}/witness-curtain-leak.html .artifacts/kiro/showdown-board-review/{{expected_sha}}/privacy/hotseat-witness` (expected exit NON-ZERO with output containing `card ids behind the curtain`; RV-03, BZ-09)
3. Negative control: `node scripts/browser-showdown-board-zones.mjs .artifacts/kiro/showdown-board-review/{{expected_sha}}/witness-curtain-leak.html .artifacts/kiro/showdown-board-review/{{expected_sha}}/privacy/zones-witness` (expected exit NON-ZERO; RV-03, BZ-09)

If the gate recorded the QA script as missing, mark 3 blocked; if its header documents a different interface, follow it and record the exact command. An exit 0 on 2 or 3 is a mismatch: that check did not see the curtain leak. Then repeat the HEAD and candidate.html SHA-256 checks and record both. Write .artifacts/kiro/showdown-board-review/{{expected_sha}}/privacy.md: a table with step id, command, expected, observed exit, match or mismatch, IDs, the report path each check wrote, and Pending or blocked. Final response: the same table.
